**Problem: So... How Many of You Came to the Discussion?**

**Step: When λ $$=$$ $$0$$, there always exists a unique model solution.**

**Hint 1:** Consider what happens to the ridge regression model when the regularization parameter λ is set to $$0$$. How does this affect the model's ability to handle multicollinearity or singular matrices?

**Hint 2:** Think about the properties of the design matrix in linear regression. When λ $$=$$ $$0$$, ridge regression reduces to ordinary least squares (OLS). Under what conditions does OLS fail to provide a unique solution?
